text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the beginning of Tokai
Teio's
training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Helloooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear an excited voice, and turn to see...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio shouts and leaps over the
high fence
surrounding the track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Enter the graceful Teio! Morning,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm fine! That was a breeze
for the
invincible Teio!
choice_data_list: 柵を飛び越えたら危ないぞ
柵を飛び越えたら危ないよ
choice_data_list_en: It's dangerous to jump over the fence.
It's dangerous to jump over the fence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was an unbelievable jump. Once
more, I'm
struck by the incredible
physical prowess she
possesses.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, today we start training for real,
yeah? I'll do
anything, so lay it on me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna take down Prez, I gotta give
it my all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So let's get down to business! I'll follow
your lead,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And that makes five laps around the
track!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, what's next? Hit me with whatever
you got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! That's it?!
choice_data_list: 今ので最後だったんだけど……
choice_data_list_en: That was supposed to be the last one, though...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nghh! Why are you going easy on me?
Don't you
know I'm the invincible Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I know, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's not the point! I'm never
gonna beat
Prez if I don't go the extra
mile!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just come with me for a second! You'll

understand!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whew, look at that gaggle of onlookers!
She
always draws a crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look over there, Trainer! On the
track!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for training with me,
President Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're facing your first graded race, so
I'm sure
you are anxious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope this session leaves you with
something that
can help you improve.
Now, please, give it your
all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez is about to start her partner
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf begins to run slowly in
order to
guide her inexperienced
partner. Until...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if she could hear Tokai Teio, Symboli
Rudolf
shoots off, leaving her partner far
behind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! She's still speeding up?!
That's two
lengths, three lengths, and...
she's crossed the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Every time I see Prez in action, I
can't help
but sing her praises!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I felt the same thing when I saw Tokai
Teio run.
That complete and total
control over the race.
It's...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So you get it now, right? The way Prez
runs.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She's got the instincts and the smarts to
read a
race, and the legs to make it
happen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't just keep training like normal! I
need super
training!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So let's get back to it! I gotta keep
running!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now that was a great workout!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I bet it's taught you a thing or two
about how
much training I really need,
too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, great!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing about Prez. Nobody can
catch up
to her by just doing the normal
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The outcome of a race is never
certain—unless
Symboli Rudolf is running
in it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you said something like that about any
other
Umamusume, it'd sound
ridiculous...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But when I see Prez run, I know it's true.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not just me who thinks that. Everyone
feels
it—that's why it's such a popular
quote.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes Prez amazing. Anyone
who
sees her is completely captivated
by her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And that's the kind of Umamusume I'm
gonna be!
I'll surpass even Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll become so great that no matter how
big a goal
I aim for, everyone'll believe I
can do it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! You better set your sights
sky-high, Trainer!
choice_data_list_en: Let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna surpass Prez for sure!
And to
do that, I'll run my heart out
again tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tokai Teio's challenge starts
now!
